subject: KwikBucks status: reproduction done, weak-signal quality drives everything
body:
Hi Dmitri, Daniela,

Status update. Reproduction closed on Apr 6 (three days late, dataset mirroring hiccup): KwikBucks matches the paper's numbers on the released datasets and beats every baseline in the repo at equal strong-query budget, as expected.

Main finding as we move to the internal corpus: the budget-vs-quality curve is extremely sensitive to weak-signal quality. With Paloma's current embedding pipeline, we reach 0.91 F1 on the labeled dedup sample using strong queries on just 2.3% of candidate pairs. But when we swapped in the older embedding model as a stress test, the same budget only gets 0.78 — the ordering the algorithm consumes really matters, not just the budget.

Risk: the cross-encoder service Oyin is building has a 40ms p50 per pair; at prototype scale fine, but platform-scale nightly runs will need batching work we haven't scoped. Flagging now so Jun 15 go/no-go includes it.

Carmen
